scope.reference_semantics: artifact_fp32_strict_v1; CPU-only; no runtime context, HIP, BLAS, activation quantization, or GPU
scope.measurement_mode: --no-capture for SMT scaling; only small receipts and logs were written

host.smt_sibling_mapping: logical CPU N and N+64 are siblings for N=0..63

active_capture_baseline.configuration: 8 processes x 8 threads; disjoint physical logical CPUs 0-63
active_capture_baseline.note: This is the requested >=3 minute in-progress corpus-capture baseline, including its normal capture behavior.

method.steady_state_forward_per_second_definiti: total forwards divided by the largest per-process sum of forward elapsed times; initialization excluded
method.wall_forward_per_second_definition: total forwards divided by all-process launch-to-last-finish wall time; initialization included
method.peak_rss_kib_sum_definition: sum of each process's individually observed peak RSS; it is not a simultaneous aggregate RSS measurement

configurations.name: physical-8x8
configurations.affinity_pattern: eight disjoint 8-CPU physical-core sets covering CPUs 0-63

configurations.name: smt-14x8-split-siblings
configurations.affinity_pattern: eight physical 8-CPU sets (0-63) plus six sibling-only 8-CPU sets (64-111); siblings are in different processes

configurations.name: smt-14x8-paired-siblings
configurations.affinity_pattern: 14 workers each receive four physical CPU pairs; CPUs 0-55 and 64-119 are used, leaving eight physical pairs for the OS

configurations.name: smt-16x8-split-siblings
configurations.affinity_pattern: sixteen disjoint 8-CPU sets covering CPUs 0-127; every SMT pair is in separate processes

configurations.name: smt-7x16-paired-siblings
configurations.affinity_pattern: seven workers each receive eight physical CPU pairs; CPUs 0-55 and 64-119 are used, leaving eight physical pairs for the OS

resume_and_capture_integrity.smt_14x8_read_only_resume_validation: pass; scheduler-only change is compatible with the existing 8-thread worker plans
resume_and_capture_integrity.smt_7x16_read_only_resume_validation: rejected before launch because the immutable corpus identity includes threads_per_process=8

direct_capture_sample.comparison: published capture metadata forward summaries versus physical-8x8 no-capture recomputation

selected_resume.meaning: Every replayed position verifies existing metadata and every captured payload SHA-256 before the worker can continue; no published directory was overwritten.

selection.configuration: 8 processes x 8 threads on disjoint physical logical CPUs 0-63
selection.reason: The best SMT result is only 1.003265855x the physical no-capture steady rate (0.33%); full SMT and paired-sibling layouts are materially slower. The gain is below the requested few-percent decision threshold and does not justify a scheduler change.

remaining_time_estimate.caveat: This is a runtime estimate, not a completion guarantee. It excludes future worker initialization, later-context cost changes, and capture/filesystem variability. The launcher plan declares 28,853 forwards; this verified total is used instead of the uncorroborated 23,556 figure in the request.
